data.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD4: When this story is complete, unit tests are written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Overview
Create tests/scripts/test-respond-to-pr-comments-skill.sh to verify the structural
requirements of the respond-to-pr-comments skill. Tests must fail (RED) before the
SKILL.md is created, then pass (GREEN) after Task 2 completes.

## File Impact
- CREATE: tests/scripts/test-respond-to-pr-comments-skill.sh
- MODIFY: .test-index (add RED marker)

## Test Approach
Given: a repository without plugins/dso/skills/respond-to-pr-comments/SKILL.md
When: the test script is run
Then: it exits non-zero (file not found)

Given: plugins/dso/skills/respond-to-pr-comments/SKILL.md exists with required content
When: the test script is run  
Then: it exits 0 with all tests passing

## Tests to Write
1. SKILL.md file exists at plugins/dso/skills/respond-to-pr-comments/SKILL.md
2. SKILL.md name field contains "respond-to-pr-comments"
3. SKILL.md contains "No unresolved comments found on PR #" message pattern
4. SKILL.md contains classification criteria for accept, defend, defer
5. SKILL.md contains a summary table section (comment ID, classification, action taken)

Note: These are structural tests for an LLM skill file — behavioral tests of the
prose content are the only form of verification possible for a SKILL.md artifact.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] tests/scripts/test-respond-to-pr-comments-skill.sh exists and is executable
  Verify: test -x tests/scripts/test-respond-to-pr-comments-skill.sh
- [ ] All 5 structural tests are implemented in the test file
  Verify: grep -c "echo.*Test" tests/scripts/test-respond-to-pr-comments-skill.sh | awk '{exit ($1 < 5)}'
- [ ] Test file exits non-zero before SKILL.md is created (RED phase verified)
  Verify: # Verified manually during RED phase — SKILL.md should not exist yet
- [ ] .test-index updated with RED marker for respond-to-pr-comments skill
  Verify: grep '\[test_respond_to_pr_comments_skill_exists\]' .test-index
- [ ] bash tests/run-all.sh passes (exit 0) after SKILL.md is created
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
data.title: Write RED tests for respond-to-pr-comments SKILL.md existence and required content
